stateSemantics.LEGAL_CLEAR: Owner authorizes both disposition-specific branches with existing statutory safeguards and source reconciliation. Does not grant counsel/packet/raster/terminal/commercial/production approval.

decisions.bindingProductRule: Retain official SCA-C903 only where record establishes outright dismissal within supported §61-11-25 branch. Fill dismissal allegations only from actual dismissal facts. Preserve current source identity/version handling; do not alter printed dismissal allegations. Generate separate LegalEase court-facing civil petition under W. Va. Code §61-11-25, styled acquittal-specific with ordinary circuit-court caption/traditional pleading. Do not file SCA-C903 with repurposed/relabeled/falsely completed dismissal blanks. State only supported participant/movant identity, circuit court and underlying court/case identifiers, arrest/charging agency, actual charges, found-not-guilty/acquittal disposition, actual acquittal-order date, at least 60 days since that order, no prior felony conviction, no related current pending charge/proceeding, and requested expungement/sealing under §61-11-25. Require certified acquittal order as participant-supplied required-before-filing attachment. Never manufacture dismissal date/reason, dismissal-based plea assertion, prosecutorial approval, court findings, or court-owned signatures/order-entry information. Both branches preserve existing §61-11-25 prior-felony disqualification, statutory exclusions, 60 days from actual acquittal/dismissal order, circuit-court destination, no filing fee or costs under §61-11-25(g), discretionary hearing, court-controlled notice to prosecutor/arresting agency if hearing set, related-pending-case check, agency certification and already-governed post-order treatment. Do not invent participant service because SCA-C903 includes certificate section; follow adopted procedure. Actual dismissal routes only to dismissal/SCA-C903; actual acquittal or found not guilty routes only to separate acquittal-specific §61-11-25 pleading. Unclear, inconsistent, mixed or unsupported disposition stops for record clarification/manual review. Never map acquittal silently to dismissal. Preserve both promised branches; do not narrow coverage. Preserve finding that both inspected SCA-C903 binaries have dismissal-only operative bodies. Correct manifest/queue binary mismatch so page ownership and identity describe actual selected official edition. Correct source-index structural classification where bound encrypted-flat PDF was labelled unreadable despite supported-reader readability. These corrections do not change statutory branch decision or authorize rewriting official source allegations. Implementation only: no packet PASS, independent acceptance, raster PASS, commercial or production authority. Builder tests must prove exclusive dismissal/acquittal routing, no dismissal allegation in any acquittal fixture, no silent conversion of dismissal to acquittal, unclear-disposition refusal, required-before-filing certified acquittal order, protected judicial fields blank, and shared stops/instructions in both branches. Then independent semantics, current-byte raster/original-page review and native integration through existing gates. Do not reopen merely because SCA-C903 lacks acquittal allegation; that defect motivates adopted treatment.
